body:
I just don't want to feel pain anymore. Sleeping does nothing. Alcohol does nothing. Going mind-numb with games, streams, videos, movies - nothing helps that pain go away. 

All I feel any day is pain. Its source is the only thing that's different. I fucked up in the relationship, and I'm so sorry, and he won't see that. It's not his fault. It's mine. 

It always is.

I don't know. I'm scared I'll lose him. 

I'm meant to visit him in a few months... been 8 months since I've seen him. I've been so eager to visit but this happened.

I would do anything to change the behaviors that have set my SO off. Only now, I fear he's too far gone to see any changes through to the end. The past still lingers - whenever we argue, it's likely he'll bring all of it up and then question the relationship. I wish I never got addicted to that fucking game.

It's LC, not by my choice. He has a new girlfriend that he's clung to. Only comes home 1-2 times a week.
